name: pulse-arc
description: Pulse x Arc - policy-controlled AI-agent execution, deterministic verification, and reproducible action proofs on Arc Testnet.

paragraphs: Pulse — Arc is an AI-agent and developer-tooling integration that explores policy-controlled execution, deterministic verification, and reproducible action proofs on Arc.

Pulse is a larger opportunity and action-intelligence system. This standalone package exposes only the Arc integration layer: a bounded action model, explicit human approval, deterministic evidence, and a minimal proof registry. Proprietary discovery, production collectors, owner data, Telegram infrastructure, and private configuration are not included.

Arc provides an EVM-compatible testnet execution and receipt-verification environment with native test USDC gas/value semantics. A final receipt gives Pulse a deterministic boundary between an approved action and a public, reproducible proof reference.
features: Arc Testnet integration — a bounded adapter that talks to Arc Testnet (chain ID 5042002) only, verifying chain identity before any prepared action.

Policy-controlled execution architecture — the agent can propose an action but cannot self-approve; every state-changing action requires an explicit, scoped, human-approved reference before execution.
Deterministic verification — the adapter checks receipt status, block, and finality against the exact prepared action before anything is treated as executed.
Participation Proof — a canonicalized, reproducible action record (actionId, proofHash) computed with a fixed key set, sorted keys, and no floating-point amounts (see scripts/proofcanonicalizer.py).

PulseActionProofRegistry — a minimal, non-custodial onchain commitment layer for the two bytes32 values above. It has no token, custody, withdrawal, upgrade, admin mutation, or arbitrary external-call path.
